Message:
scsi: megaraid_sas: Re-Define enum DCMD_RETURN_STATUS

DCMD_INIT is introduced to indicate the initial DCMD status, which was
earlier set to MFI status.  DCMD_BUSY indicates the resource is busy or
locked.
